subject.title: Walnut Valley Water District Board, Division 5, Partial Term

text: As a resident of the Walnut Valley Water District service area since 2002, a technology executive, and a homeowners association board member, I understand the importance of responsible leadership, careful financial oversight, and dependable infrastructure. My goal is simple: to help ensure our community has safe, reliable, and affordable water while providing transparent and fiscally responsible leadership.

For the past nine years, I have served as the Chief Information Officer of a nonprofit trade association, I oversee complex technology operations, cybersecurity, major projects, contracts, and multimillion-dollar budgets. I have also led more than 150 technology professionals delivering IT support and infrastructure services to over 30,000 employees worldwide. This experience has taught me to evaluate long-term investments, manage risk, hold vendors accountable, and balance service quality with cost.

I am also a member of the Board of Directors of my homeowners association and currently serve as Treasurer, overseeing budgets, reserve funding, financial reporting, vendor contracts, and long-term capital planning. This hands-on experience is directly relevant to the challenges facing WVWD, including aging infrastructure, rising imported-water costs, and the need to balance necessary investments with customer affordability.
If elected, my priorities will be:

- Promoting transparency, accountability, and responsible use of public funds
- Carefully scrutinizing rate proposals and capital projects to ensure ratepayer dollars are spent wisely
- Managing reserves prudently and investing responsibly in aging infrastructure
- Strengthening emergency preparedness, cybersecurity, and operational resilience
- Supporting practical water conservation without placing unreasonable burdens on residents and businesses
- Listening and responding to the needs of everyone in Division 5

Water is one of our community's most essential resources. Decisions made today will affect its reliability, affordability, and infrastructure for decades. I will review the facts, ask hard questions, and make decisions based on our community's best interests.
Public officials should be accessible, transparent, and accountable. I will bring an independent perspective, strong business and technology experience, and a collaborative approach to the Board.
My wife and I have been married for 21 years and are raising our two children in this community, where they attend local public schools.
It would be an honor to represent Division 5. I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: "It has been an honor and privilege to serve as your appointed Director for Walnut Valley Water District Division V. I am grateful for the opportunity to serve the communities of City of Industry, Pomona, West Covina, Diamond Bar, and Walnut. As a Diamond Bar resident since 1999, business owner, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), and business advisor, I care deeply about the future of our community and the quality of services our residents and businesses receive.

I believe serving on the Board is both a responsibility and a privilege. I am committed to listening to our residents, working closely with Walnut Valley Water District staff and my fellow Board Members, and making thoughtful decisions that put the interests of our communities first.

As a CPA and business owner, I understand the importance of sound financial management, careful budgeting, and planning for the future. I believe every taxpayer dollar should be treated with respect and used responsibly. At the same time, we must continue investing in our water system, maintaining critical infrastructure, protecting our water supply, and ensuring reliable, high-quality water service for our communities.

I also believe good government starts with being accessible, transparent, and accountable. I want residents and businesses to know that their concerns are heard and that their elected representatives are working on their behalf.

I am honored to serve as your appointed incumbent and respectfully ask for your vote so I can continue serving Division V. I will bring the same integrity, professionalism, dedication, and commitment to our community that I bring to my work as a CPA and business owner.
Thank you for the opportunity to serve and for your trust and support."
